article.story: CLEVELAND -- — Tevin Smith scored 23 points as Cleveland State beat Detroit Mercy 65-50 on Wednesday night. Smith also contributed six rebounds and three steals for the Vikings (15-6, 9-1 Horizon League). Je'Shawn Stevenson scored 13 points while going 4 of 9 from the floor, including 1 for 4 from 3-point range, and 4 for 4 from the line. Dylan Arnett and Tahj Staveskie each had eight points. It was the 11th win in a row for the Vikings. Orlando Lovejoy led the way for the Titans (6-15, 2-8) with 14 points. Ryan Kalambay added 10 points, nine rebounds and two blocks for Detroit Mercy. TJ Nadeau had seven points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
